claim_ceiling: Evaluation lane is DONE. All 9 benchmarks established and verified, 10 fractal-map representations evaluated against 5 targets, 2 baselines documented. This is the second operational resume confirming the same conclusions as run 33030061655. No durable delta. Lane remains complete.

diagnosis.orchestration_failure: Run 33030407701 was dispatched to the evaluation lane after it had already reached DONE status. The lane state at dispatch time had cycle_status=COMPLETED, continue_recommended=false, next_recommendation=DONE, and evidence_tier=REPRODUCED. This is the same failure mode as run 33030061655.
diagnosis.root_cause: The factory supervisor lacks a pre-dispatch check for lane completion status. Once a lane reaches DONE with continue_recommended=false, subsequent dispatches should be blocked or redirected to the Factory Director for a successor question. This is the second occurrence of this failure, confirming it is systematic rather than transient.
diagnosis.resolution: No durable delta needed. Lane was already complete. Audit gate created, state updated with new run_id and audit_refs. All 26 evidence_refs and 6 audit_refs verified to exist on disk.
diagnosis.supervisor_recommendation: Add a pre-dispatch guard: before dispatching to any core lane, read state/<lane>.json and block if cycle_status=COMPLETED and continue_recommended=false. Redirect to Factory Director for successor question assignment.

known_defects.description: bench_legal_area() in run_cycle_6.py and run_cycle_7.py omits metric='cosine' and linkage='average' (used in run_cycle_5.py), defaulting to Euclidean/Ward. Affects cross-cycle NMI comparability but not cycle 7 internal validity.
known_defects.note: Known limitation documented. Cycle 5 results use cosine/average; cycle 6+ results use Euclidean/Ward. Cross-cycle NMI values are not directly comparable. Within-cycle comparisons are valid.
